column3: Explore: bundled first-party catalogue (plugins/explore: 8 skills, 9 themes) with sha256 pinned per entry in lock.ts and checked by the client before skill.put or addCatalogTheme; themes are three-colour palettes per variant, not full token maps
column4: Appearance derives and contrast-repairs every token from {accent, background, foreground}, so a palette is the unit a theme is stored as; pinning the hash makes catalogue edits visible in review and lets the client refuse altered content; bundled data costs 0 storage reads and writes
column5: plugins/explore/explore.test.ts (pins match content, search, entry, skill.put accepts a bundled skill); live explore.search on wrangler dev
column6: kept; market indexes do not contribute skills or themes yet (needs a market index format change in plugins/market, owned by #35); Featured is the first 4 index entries because market.search carries no sort key or publish time; tablist is hand-rolled with ARIA roles because @ui-sdk/web is not installed
